title: Chapter 230: The Powerful Human Army
content:
Chapter 230: The Powerful Human Army

Wu Qing also felt that it was a bit difficult to deal with after learning about the situation of the goblins.

"They are indeed difficult guys. No one has the time to clean them up!"

"When things stabilize here, let the Zerg puppies play with them!"

Wu Qing instantly thought of the Zerg puppies, which are simply the nemesis of these goblins. As long as the number of Zerg puppies reaches a certain level, it is not difficult to help the local camp clean up the trouble of the goblins.

The Zerg army has reached the outside of the main city, and everything depends on itself. Wu Qing commands the Zerg army to march quickly in the direction where the main force of the evil god camp, the alien human army, is infested according to some simulated intelligence provided by Gong Rui and the real-time intelligence collected by the Zerg host at high altitude.

50,000 fully upgraded Zerg flying dragons are scattered around the Zerg ground forces. When they find the goblins, they send out the corresponding troops and fly over to bomb them.

They are basically ordinary goblins. In front of the biological bombs of the Zerg flying dragons, which have the lowest strength of one star, they are basically killed after a round of attacks.

Only some weapons, equipment and clothing that were corroded beyond recognition were left.

When the local army fought with the goblins, the Zerg army would not intervene if the local army had the upper hand. If the local army was at a disadvantage, the Zerg dragons would go to help.

This allowed many local armies to have direct contact with the Zerg.

The Zerg army swept through, and the flying troops swept everywhere, killing the annoying goblins wherever they passed, which was very high-profile.

Those local races and forces that were interested sent elite scouts to follow the Zerg army, wanting to find out the details of the Zerg.

In this public battlefield, all the major races have their own intelligence networks, and the Zerg's every move is now under their eyes.

From another perspective, from the moment the Zerg army stepped out of the main city, the Zerg officially stepped into the big stage of the public battlefield in the southern theater and began to perform.

The farther away from the main city, the more local army troops you encounter. Except for some weak troops being entangled by goblins, most of them are on the march.

There are also many troops in the camp and rest state, and there are many empty camps scattered everywhere.

The Zerg army has entered a concentrated camping area for the local army. The protection range of the lord of the main city is beyond imagination. These places are strange and cannot be entered at will.

The Zerg army marches very fast. Going further out, you will start to encounter troops withdrawing from the battlefield. There are troops of various races, and the casualties are very serious.

Wu Qing personally came forward and asked the troops withdrawing from the battlefield about some situations. It turned out that not far ahead, there was an elite force of the alien race clearing the field, attracting many local army troops to besiege.

There are no main forces of the three powerful races stationed in the 108th District. The armies of other races are really no match for the elite troops of the alien race.

These elite troops of the alien race often go deep into the hinterland of the local camp and attack the army of the local camp.

In the public battlefield, the army of the local camp has no unified command and each does its own thing. When facing a strong enemy, some ethnic armies choose to flee, while others choose to fight, and basically cannot form an effective joint force.

Unless the ethnic strength is so strong that a large number of ethnic armies are willing to attach to it, it is possible to concentrate forces to fight a decisive battle with the evil god camp.

However, it is very difficult to achieve this step. The public battlefield is under the surveillance of the big clans. The weak small races do not obey you and can also disobey your orders. This is their freedom. No matter how strong you are, you cannot threaten them.

To succeed here, strength, prestige and human relations are all indispensable.

The current 108th District is not dominated by a strong clan, and it is almost a mess. It is okay when the vassal race army of the alien race goes to war, and the various ethnic armies of the local camp can fight with them in a good way.

As long as the elite troops of the alien race go to battle, the overconfident and unwilling to admit defeat racial armies in the local camp will suffer heavy losses.

The racial armies that did not suffer losses were all the racial armies that fled to avoid fighting. Such races were evaluated very low in the eyes of the big clans.

Sometimes the alien army fought too much, and the army of the big clans in the local camp would take action to save some face.

The alien race was originally a super big clan in the evil god camp. Although the army that came here was only under the command of an archbishop, it was still a bit bullying.

This public battlefield in the southern theater was originally a training ground. Now that there are strong sparring partners, it is not easy for the big clans to go out in person.

If the powerful sparring partner of the alien race can create a big clan in the local camp, it is acceptable to have more losses.

The increase in the number of big clans in this camp not only strengthens the strength of the camp, but also strengthens the luck of the camp, which is plundered from the enemy camp.

The impact of this increase and decrease is very large.

Therefore, the identity and status of this big tribe is not as simple as imagined.

As soon as the Zerg army came on the field, they encountered the main force of the alien race. I don’t know whether it is good luck or bad luck.

Wu Qing felt that this was very good. If you want to fight, fight the most fierce one. This can best reflect strength. Now the system’s resources are very sufficient. No matter what the situation of the alien race is, the Zerg army can deal with it calmly.

With the guidance of others, the Zerg army's goal became clearer. After marching forward for a while, the Zerg host in the air could already see the situation on the battlefield ahead.

A huge snow-white army stood in the middle as steady as a rock. It was besieged from all sides, but it was not at all inferior.

Wu Qing could see clearly through the perspective of the Zerg host that it was a human army. All members were equipped with white armor, which looked very shocking.

Above this human army, there was also a flying soldier hovering. Its appearance looked a bit like the griffin in Wu Qing's impression, but its hair was also snow-white.

Wu Qing looked at the human army more closely. The Zerg host could see spearmen, greatswordsmen, great shieldmen, crossbowmen, cavalry, mages and priests, as well as some other soldiers that were not seen due to obstructed vision. In addition to some detailed classifications of the soldiers seen, this human army looked very systematic.

They were also equipped with a large number of siege weapons similar to those created by the goblins, and they carried a large amount of combat supplies with them.

This was the first time Wu Qing saw a human army in this world, and a familiar feeling came to him.

"When will my army be born?"

Wu Qing missed his human army a little.

Now it has become a human army in the world affiliated with the system. As long as it is born, it will be easy to sweep across this world, but this can only be thought of, it is very unrealistic.

The system cannot directly resist the suppression of the will of the universe, and can only make adjustments.

Unfortunately, the human army that Wu Qing saw for the first time was the enemy. From a distance, he could feel that the army was filled with a strong atmosphere of faith, which was the purest and most fanatical faith energy.

The army in this state in this world has no way to communicate in a normal way. They only have the will of the gods in their hearts, and they don’t care about life and death, let alone other things?

Therefore, this kind of human race is no longer the same kind. Facing such an enemy, there is no other way except to fight him.

The strength of this alien army is very large, and the logistics personnel are all fully armed and combat-ready soldiers. The total strength is roughly estimated to be around five million.

Around them, there are several large-scale local camp armies launching attacks, and there are many other armies assisting.

The total strength of the local camp army is more than that of the alien army, but they are all fighting on their own, and the cooperation depends entirely on tacit understanding and experience.

This war should have lasted for a while. The goblin-made siege weapons on the local camp army have all stopped, and it seems that there is no ammunition.

The siege weapons of the alien army occasionally provide long-range support, and the energy explosive bombs and dense heavy crossbows fired are very powerful.

The main combat output of the alien army is the crossbow soldiers. They are all equipped with a heavy crossbow, which is stronger and more sophisticated than the heavy crossbows equipped by the soldiers of the Green Department of the Bear Goblin Clan.

A large number of archers from the alien tribe attacked the army of the local camp under the protection of the melee troops in front and the heavy shield soldiers around them.

The crossbows they fired were attached with energy, with a very long range and powerful power. Soldiers from the local camp army with one-star strength would be either killed or injured if they were hit by arrows.

The long-range attack launched by the local camp army had very limited killing effect on the alien soldiers wrapped like tin cans.

Moreover, the alien soldiers seemed to have all practiced a kind of faith magic. Their own defense, physical fitness and recovery speed were very strong. With the blessing of the magic of the priests accompanying the army, ordinary attacks could not move them at all.

Facing the melee troops of various races in the local camp that rushed to the vicinity, the well-trained spearmen, great swordsmen and great shield soldiers of the alien army cooperated in combat, defending and killing the enemy, taking turns to fight, and had a tacit understanding.

The melee troops of various races in the local camp that rushed up were not large tribe armies. Even if they had the same level of strength, the difference in combat power was still particularly obvious, and the losses were very heavy.

"This is a systemic crush! The two sides are not at the same level at all!"

Wu Qing saw the essence of this war.

As the Zerg army got closer, Wu Qing could see more details of the battlefield.

The battlefield command, combat will, soldier strength, weapons and equipment, combat experience, logistics support, etc. of the alien army were much stronger than the local army.

It was impossible for the local army to defeat the alien army by attacking like this.
